title: Annual Mangrove Loss Fell To 102,000 Hectares
hook: Mangrove destruction slowed to 102,000 hectares a year.
closing: Slower loss proves protection can work, but coastlines still need recovery.
question: Can mangroves recover?

segments.say: Mangrove forest area fell to 15.2 million hectares. Coastlines lost natural protection with it.
Asia lost 1.9 million hectares of mangroves. It carried the largest regional loss shown.
Annual mangrove loss fell to 102,000 hectares. The decline proves destruction can slow.
